TEXT: The taste was so bad, I spurted it out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What the heck is this?! Is this even edible?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Hah?! It's delicious, isn't it?! Since I'm the one that 
made it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's hellishly bad. I can only consider this harassment.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Come on, don't lie. Look at Dad, he's eating like it's 
super-delicious.

When I looked over, he was eagerly eating the 
horrible-tasting stewed dish made by Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
There's no way I can leave any of my daughter's 
cooking on the table uneaten.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Dad... does this taste good to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You're eating it with such a composed expression.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
It brings back memories. It tastes just like your 
mother's cooking in the past.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Learn this well, Kyousuke. You have to gulp it down 
before your tongue can taste it.

He can't leave a dish prepared by someone 
important to him untouched.
However, if it tastes bad, he'll outright say it's bad.
What a solid and consistent attitude.
I'll try to follow his example too.

I started digging into the stewed food with spirited 
vigor.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
No way... Even though Ayase went on and on about 
my cooking being delicious...

Kirino picked up some of the stewed food with 
chopsticks and put it in her mouth.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Kirino, make sure to sample your cooking properly 
next time.

Which reminds me, on that day when Kirino made 
chocolate cookies--

So the reason why Ayase was holding her stomach 
in pain by the roadside... it's due to her eating all of 
Kirino's cookies by herself, huh.
What incredible willpower. As expected of Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hmm, so she ate it all... What a greedy girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
W-What are you looking at? Sorry... for not being 
able to cook well enough.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Since you're the one who cooked it, you must have 
put all your effort into making it, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That alone is enough to make me happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
That's right~. Next time, I'll teach you how to make 
curry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: If I do that, will you... eat my cooking again?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, of course. I'll be looking forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
What's this? You siblings are really getting along 
well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: E-Eh? Does it seem that way?

The thing about us siblings not being related by 
blood.

Dad's probably been worried about us knowing the 
truth.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry for worrying you. But... we're fine now.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: See, it's just like I said. Right, dear?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
It's about something you're too dense to notice, 
dear.

Though that was pointed out to him, Dad didn't get 
mad, and just quietly nodded.

That was probably his way of saying that he's 
"leaving it to Mom".

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Don't you have... something to say to your father?
Staying silent, she stared at us with a serious gaze.

On the other hand, Dad didn't seem to understand 
anything.

But, he seemed to have sensed that something 
unusual was going on from Mom's behavior.

Our brief moment of calm and harmony had 
changed completely.
A period of silence continued for a while, and then--

This was inevitable, we had to do it at some point 
anyway.
It's better to do this sooner rather than later.
I took a big deep breath.

No matter what happens... I swear I'll protect Kirino 
till the end.
Now that I'm ready, I smiled for some reason.

I mean, meeting with my girlfriend's parents, letting 
them acknowledging our relationship... that kind of 
thing.
And yet, my girlfriend is my little sister.
Kirino's my little sister, she's also my girlfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I have something important to tell you both.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's why, I've decided to stay with her forever.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Is that all you wanted to say?
There's no meaning in piling on lots of words to it.

I'm not the type that's capable of persuading them 
through complex reasoning anyway.

Of course, I doubt I can get them to accept it that 
easily.

Even so... Now was the time for a straightforward 
approach.

Normally, in a situation like this, shouldn't they be 
strongly opposed, driving us into a crisis?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
It's because we don't really have any reason to 
object.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: If you two were truly blood-related siblings...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: It'd be a completely different story, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If you're her partner, I don't have to feel uneasy 
about giving Kirino away in marriage.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Don't you ever forget the resolve you displayed 
just now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course. I know that without being told.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yeah. Prove to us that you're not just all talk.
Kirino and I faced each other and nodded...

We gave that reply from the bottom of our hearts 
to our parents.
